name: mamuphp/runtime
description: Runtime for .phpm components: a Symfony bundle with Twig rendering, class components as services, pages as Symfony routes, and Turbo/Stimulus state.

suggest.doctrine/doctrine-bundle: To run the event handlers of #[Transactional] components in a Doctrine ORM transaction, and to give #[Path] props the entities of their route values
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To load the mamu Stimulus controller and its CSS with an importmap (the mamujs assets)
suggest.symfony/stimulus-bundle: To register the mamu Stimulus controller from assets/controllers.json
